aboutTitle: We have been at this since 1984.
aboutParagraphs: ARSK & Associates was established as a partnership firm of Chartered Accountants in 1984, with a founding commitment to delivering independent, objective, and technically sound counsel to business clients.

Four decades later, the firm's core commitments have not changed — but the practice has grown significantly in both depth and scope. Today, ARSK operates from offices in Kolkata and Mumbai, with a team of partners and a professional staff that spans Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, and advisory specialists.

We serve founders and promoters of growing companies, family businesses navigating succession and governance, CFOs of mid-market enterprises who need a reliable sounding board, and multinationals entering or operating in India. Our clients come to us because they want advisors who understand their business — not just their balance sheet.

orgIntro: Our practice is structured around three integrated areas of service, ensuring aligned execution across disciplines:

departments.name: Attestation and Audit
departments.desc: Statutory audits under the Companies Act, tax audits under the Income Tax Act, forensic investigations, compliance reviews, and specialized certification assignments.

departments.name: Risk Assurance and Management
departments.desc: Internal audits, concurrent audits, systems, process, and internal control reviews, information systems (IS) audits, and technology acquisition support.

departments.name: Transaction Advisory and Taxation
departments.desc: Corporate advisory, M&A buy-side/sell-side support, business and asset valuations, corporate law compliance (ROC, SEBI, FEMA, RBI), and domestic/international taxation representation.

departments.name: Outsourced CFO & Virtual Finance
departments.desc: Outsourced finance function management, MIS design and reporting, Financial planning and analysis support, among other similar services.
